configuration.ces_weights: (1,0) for skill-0 demand and (0,1) for skill-1 demand; fixed before evaluation, no cross-skill synergy
configuration.continuation: Existing P0ProductionOnly in all conditions; no subsequent teaching.

hypotheses.H1: Teaching may complement MIS when it opens subsequent productive exposure.
hypotheses.H2: Teaching may substitute for MIS when the learner already exercises the skill.
hypotheses.H3: The interaction may depend on future demand.

configuration.initial_information: Explicit calibrated means equal numerical initial skills with variance .0025; same grid posterior and empty efficacy memory in all branches. No policy reads truth.
configuration.negative_control: Additional deterministic B quadruple at zero efficacy; effort and allocation cost remain.
configuration.primary_estimand: I_R = (R11-R01)-(R10-R00), conditional on scenario, P0 continuation, observation model and fixed initial state.
configuration.randomness: Demand fixed by scenario; independent replicate seeds vary indexed individual/formative Gaussian observation innovations; four branches share innovations by coordinate.

A_substitution_candidate.rationale: Learner 0.45 already exceeds reserve 0.25 in skill 0; both mechanisms can develop an already productive skill.

B_enabling_candidate.rationale: Learner 0.20 starts below reserve 0.25; the specified lesson can close this rank gap. Participation is endogenous, not prohibited by a gate.

C_demand_change.rationale: Same team as B; exogenous switch at period 12 from skill 0 to skill 1 changes relevance of the taught skill.

configuration.selection: Three analytical configurations fixed before outcomes; no parameter or policy search.
configuration.uncertainty: Paired seed SD, range, MCSE and percentile bootstrap 95% interval for conditional noise-mean (5000 resamples, seed 2026101599); deterministic fixtures have no interval; no significance tests.
